Name: Stone Farmhouse

Description:
[b]Author's Note:

[/b]Hello, everyone!
One day I decided to make this mod for myself and posted it here on a whim, since I liked the stone cabin aesthetic. Due to a lack of time and modding knowledge, unfortunately, I could not keep up with updates and such, I am also not an artist, so the cabin was made entirely by shifting around assets found in the base game. However, someone else also had the idea to transport the stone cabin aesthetic to the main farmhouse, and the result is amazing! Please check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30014 ]Byeol's Seasonal Stone House Edit[/url]﻿ and support the mod 😀
[b]
Description:
[/b]
